svg.title: Serverless limits
svg.desc: A spike of 900 uploads arrives. With no limits, the platform starts 900 function copies, each opens its own database connection, and Postgres, which allows 100, refuses them. Then the same spike with a concurrency cap of 300 and a connection proxy: extra uploads wait in the queue and Postgres sees only 50 connections.
svg.text: 900 copies open 900 connections. A cap and a proxy keep Postgres alive.
